name: aifactory-code
description: Build new itm8 solutions that fit the AI Factory from the first line: a design interview, the pinned AI Factory build rules, starters for web apps (Fastify + React + PostgreSQL with Entra auth), MCP servers, AI agents (Microsoft Agent Framework or an in-app agent with human approval) and Microsoft 365 Copilot agents, the itm8 design system, a light spec-first flow (spec, plan with signed AI Factory gates, tasks, failing-test-first bug fixes, a GitHub Spec Kit preset), one change gate before any code (scope, a trust-boundary line with a refusal test per boundary, then the smallest change), a deterministic build check, a secret guard and a code guard that blocks unsafe code at write time, a command guard that stops reckless shell commands and asks before destructive ones, a guard that asks before CI and infrastructure edits, the AI Factory gate installer (a required check before merge and a secret check before every commit), a submit command that takes a change to a pull request in plain steps, a current-versions skill, three working-discipline skills from obra/superpowers (MIT), and Cloudflare's security-audit skill for full source audits. Never deploys to dev or production.
